test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Pipes P and Q can fill a completely empty tank in 24 minutes and in 36 minutes, respectively, when opened independently. Pipe R can empty the completely filled tank in 30 minutes. Initially all the three pipes P, Q and R, are opened simultaneously. After how many minutes should pipe Q be closed so that the tank is filled in 1 hour?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe P to fill a tank = 24 min

Time taken by Pipe Q to fill a tank = 36 min

Time taken by Pipe R to fill a tank = 30 min

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

1 hour = 60 min

**Calculation:**

LCM of 24, 36 and 30 is 360

Let the height of the tank is 360m.

Efficiency of Pipe P = (360/24) = 15 i.e Pipe P can fill the tank at a rate of 15m/min

similarly,

Efficiency of Q = (360/36) = 10m/miin

Efficiency of R = (360/30) = 12m/min (rate of emptying the tank)

Now,

Let Pipe Q closed after x min

According to the question,

Pipe P will work for 60 min

Pipe Q will work for x min

Pipe R will work for 60 min

⇒ (15 × 60) + (10 × x) – (12 × 60) = 360

⇒ 900 + 10x – 720 = 360

⇒ 180 + 10x = 360

⇒ 10x = 180

⇒ x = 18 min

**∴ The required time is 18 min**
